ack_recoverability.visible: process-visible after local command-WAL recoverability and normal-executor install; does not require root publication or AppliedLSN advancement
ack_recoverability.flushed: backend roots and AppliedLSN are selected in the same backend commit
ack_recoverability.synced: flushed plus fsync-capable local durability boundary
ack_recoverability.raft_committed: reserved distributed consensus policy; not local WAL append and not deterministic command identity

entries.notes: V1 local WAL stores the accepted catalog metadata payload. A future native-wire/Raft path must lower the deterministic entry to the same catalog command before acknowledgement or wrap exact deterministic bytes in a separately tested command kind.
